newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Nam Pei Hong shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Nam Pei Hong shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Chinese medicine retailer Nam Pei Hong (Holding) Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
The company shares rose HK$0.175 to HK$0.49 on Thursday.
Nam Pei Hong is a Chinese medicine and health food retailer and manufacturer.
Last month, the company reported an interim loss of HK$85.14 million for the six months to September 1996, compared with a HK$4.86 million loss in the same period the year before.
